query:
SELECT ls.contaCustoId, cc.nome as contaNome, SUM(CAST(ls.valor AS DECIMAL(12,2))) as total, COUNT(*) as qtd
FROM lancamento_salario ls
LEFT JOIN conta_custo cc ON cc.id = ls.contaCustoId
WHERE ls.periodoCustoId = 60001
GROUP BY ls.contaCustoId, cc.nome
ORDER BY total DESC
